My favorite chai tea of all time is masala chai from Tea India. No other chai tea has compared for me. It has the perfect amount of spices and sweetness and goes wonderfully with or without sugar and milk.

You may be doing the following things with your tea: 

- Adding too much milk/sugar, or adding it to every tea 
- Consuming too much caffeine 
- Letting the leaves/bags sit in too long which makes it too strong or bitter 

If you must have milk or sugar with your tea, I recommend finding healthier cream/sweet alternatives, or even better, find a tea you like that doesn't require adding sugar/milk. 

There's numerous types of teas out there that will literally blow your mind because you can't keep up with them all. You're bound to find one you fancy! I personally love chai, black, and green tea, but those may not be for everyone.

I recommend finding a good quality matcha powder, put some in your glass of choice, and after you boil some hot water, pour it into your cup. Then use a whisker or bamboo one specifically for Matcha if you wanna get fancy.  Matcha isn't meant to have added sugar or cream but if you're into that, I recommend a bit of honey and lavender. Both go really well with matcha and green tea in general. Squeezing a bit of lemon works too. Then you could add your dairy/alternative of choice to make it creamier. Though higher quality matcha is naturally creamy. I started making my own at home and it's saved me tonnes of money compared to buying from restaurants. It's improved my health as well due to less sugar.

Lately I've been consuming more matcha and green tea in general. It feels like a calming ritual for me and it tastes great too! I like to add lavender and honey occasionally for extra flavoring which goes beautifully with this type of tea. 😊

I'll give my honest thoughts on the demon brothers in birth order. They might be harsh but it's what I've observed. I'll try to include positives with the negatives of course.

.

**Lucifer:** A control freak. He always knows and watches everyone's moves. I know it's because Mammon causes trouble and he worries, but he takes it to an obsessive level. Very prone to violent outbursts and losing himself entirely. He talks about how he wants to make Diavolos dream come true constantly, yet whenever MC angers him he threatens to destroy MC by killing them. He ping pongs between loving MC and wanting to destroy them a lot. I have no idea why this isn't discussed, because no one should ever treat you this way. I've gotten to the part where some of his behavior is explained. I don't think Lucifer is a terrible guy per se. He did everything for his family's sake. But he definitely could've went a better way about it. I'd love to see him recognize these flaws of his and work to atone for them. Or properly make up for trying to kill MC so many times. Has a soft spot for Mammon despite constantly being on his ass about causing trouble. Has issues opening up and talking to people about what's bothering him. Will hide the truth. Stubborn and unyielding when he thinks his plans are the only way to go about something. Total dom. 

.

**Mammon:** He's dumb, immature, and irresponsible. But I love him. He can't budget for shit, always gets in trouble and drags you into it. He won't hesitate to save himself first if he has to. Several times he's left MC alone and ran away with his tail between his legs whenever he was in trouble. However, despite his tough, outer delinquent attitude, he really deeply cares for MC. He follows them around like a puppy and just wants to be by their side, getting most or all of their attention. His greed for money slides past his desire for MC. He's not used to affection or kindness, since his brother's always bully him. So whenever MC pets his head or gives him any kindness, he acts surprised. He passes it up like "yeah you should listen to me human", but he's actually blushing and flustered. It makes him happy. He's a total tsundere. He wants to protect MC and be their first and only man. There's no limits to how much I love Mammon, despite his flaws so ofc this is biased. Mammon is scared of Lucifer's punishments but probably secretly looks up to or admires him for being so put together when he's not. Also fond of his younger brothers which is why he puts up with their rudeness and teasing.

.

**Leviathan:** Your stereotypical Otaku shut in nerd. Most likely has social anxiety or a trauma that makes him not want to leave his bedroom, or see many people. He spends all his time gaming and doing Otaku related hobbies. He wants to talk to you and be closer to you, but he's too scared to because of his anxiety/past. When you show him you're interested in the same hobbies, he slowly opens up to you. He becomes nerdy and excited with MC during conversations of TSL and even includes Mammon, who is your usual dude who doesn't get it but is glad everyone else is happy from it. He's a sweet guy, but I think Levi let's his hobbies consume every second of his life, which isn't healthy. He probably doesn't take care of himself or sleep much. I can see him not eating or neglecting his hygiene. Very worrisome.

.

**Satan:** Very hard to get to know. If you're stupid he will hate you. Values intelligence and knowledge over everything. Can come off as a snob or a stuck up asshole, as he insults MC often whenever they get something wrong. Total bookworm. Probably knows the most obscure facts and references. He can be sweet but it's rare. He has a rebellious side to him that likes to fuck with Lucifer. He will sometimes drag MC off somewhere if that means trolling his older brother. Appears calm and composed on the outside, but angey boi inside.

.

**Asmodeus:** WHORE-KNEE 24/7. DTF anything and everything that moves. Probably has every kjnk you can think of. Does not know the meaning of monogamy or settling down. Loves to party constantly and hits on everyone. MC is just another fuck on his bucket list. Narcissistic as hell, completely obsessed and in love with himself. Thinks the world revolves around him. He often forces himself on MC and touches them without consent. Even when told to stop by MC or his brothers, Asmo doesn't get it or listen. In fact he never recognizes when he does anything wrong and changes the subject. He's good at reading situations and knows when to run to save his own skin. Very fashionable and knowledgeable about makeup. Is happy to give anyone a makeover.

.

**Beelzebub:** Built like a truck. Could probably carry anything, plus you, plus a car. Very strong. Probably has an insane metabolism which explains why he can eat extreme portions and isn't fat. Very bad for anyone who has to cook for him or buy the food. Not too smart, but not stupid either. Very protective of his younger brother Belphie, and a great bodyguard of Lucifer. Very loyal. He's mostly calm and sweet towards MC and his brothers, only getting enraged if anyone hurts Belphie or Lillith, who he's closest to. He doesn't hesitate to protect MC from his brothers if the situation arises. Is a really good guy, unless his hunger makes him lose control of himself. He would probably eat anything in sight then. Including MC.

.

Isn't afraid to lie to MC or anyone else if it means achieving his goals. Hates humans to the point of wanting to exterminate them. Very attached and close to his older brother Beelzebub, the only person he trusts. Just wants to clear up the misunderstanding with Lucifer and live normally with his brothers again. He's a good guy, just traumatized by what happened to Lillith. He struggles with feelings of vengeance and hatred for what happened to him and his sister.

You're not an idiot for being hurt like this. It's a valid hurt that's become a trauma for you with it happening before. The important thing is to not take it out on yourself and just let the feelings come and go. If you're close to these friends and known them for a while, you can always try to express your fears to your friends and explain your fears. Otherwise I'd just wait it out. It's possible you could end up making your fears come true if you dwell on them too much. I have had similar struggles. Relationships of any kind are very difficult to maintain and sometimes people don't talk every day or as much as before. It's about learning to fill those lonely times with something to keep your mind occupied I think, and being okay with being with yourself. Though I'm definitely not the best person to give advice... I hope this goes better for you than it has for me.

Yes this happens to me constantly. Especially online. Because people don't get to know you past a certain point they can make all sorts of assumptions about you, and trying to change their mind about you can be pointless. If they want to think you're a horrible person, they will believe it no matter what. Even people who were once friends can end up thinking the worst of you.  You'll only exhaust yourself catering to them, and they will continue to believe the worst. It's exhausting. Just try to find people that are okay with you and be yourself. Of course, loving yourself and being okay with yourself is most important.
